raw_segments.text: Goneril, put on what weary negligence you please, you and your fellows, I'd have it
If he distaste it, led him to our sister, whose mind and mine, I know in that are one not
Idle old man, that still would manage those authorities that he hath given away.
Now by my life, old fools are babes again, and must be us'd with cheques as flatteries
